The Export button now works, and the fix is committed as `b6f9c19`.

**Cause:** `OrdersPage.__init__` registered a handler only for `"refresh"`. Clicking Export looked up no handler and fell through to the no-op branch in `click()`.

**Fix** (`src/orders-web/orders_page.py`): one line, `self._on("export", self.export)`, next to the refresh registration.

**Test** (`tests/test_orders_web.py`): added `test_export_button_writes_one_download`, which goes through `click("export")` and checks the download matches `to_csv(ORDERS)`. The existing export test called `export()` directly, so it never caught the missing registration.

**Verification:** the web test suite passes (5 tests), and the full discover run under `tests/` passes (9 tests). I did not run the fix against the pre-fix code to confirm the new test fails there.
